resources.string: Validate your OpenRouter key to unlock Routing and Account.
Could not apply. Check values or reload if settings changed elsewhere.
Your saved connection will stay active.
Remove the saved credentials from this connection. Linked profiles will need a key before they can chat.
Editing a replacement. Your current connection is still active.
This connection rotates multiple saved keys. Account data describes the first key only. A replacement replaces the entire key set.
Regional availability depends on your OpenRouter account. Regional requests never fall back to global automatically.
Custom gateways can be configured in provider settings, but cannot unlock direct OpenRouter account access here.
Model choice, prompts, sampling and tools belong to each profile. Provider restrictions apply to every linked profile.
Defaults apply to future calls. Profile choices inherit these restrictions.
No valid route. Resolve conflicting provider restrictions before sending.
This model is absent from the current eligible catalog. Check account preferences or select another model.
Refresh unavailable. Previously observed prices remain visible.
Selecting a strategy changes only provider sorting. Price and privacy restrictions stay in place.
Use exact provider slugs, separated by commas. Empty lists inherit server routing. Preferences are not an allowlist.
Choose a backup provider for the same model within the active restrictions.
Only route to endpoints that support all parameters sent with a request.
Maximum input price · USD per 1M tokens
Maximum output price · USD per 1M tokens
Blank means unset; zero is a real ceiling. These limits are prices per unit, not a total spending budget.
Restricts provider routing for these requests. Your account settings still apply.
Restricts upstream endpoints. It does not by itself disable OpenRouter response caching.
Disables response caching and blocks asynchronous batches with retained input or results.
Performance values are preferences, not guarantees.
Maximum image price · USD per image
Maximum request price · USD per request
Require endpoints whose terms allow text distillation. Check provider terms before use.
Uses an opaque session per connection, chat and execution lane. Provider order takes precedence.
Opt-in reuse of identical responses. Tool requests and benchmarks always request fresh output.
Interactive chat stays synchronous. Native batch inputs and results may be retained for 30 days; upstream retention varies.
Only explicitly queued workloads use this setting.
App-owned reuse, separate from provider prompt and OpenRouter response caching.
Local queue cache TTL · seconds (0 disables)
Send the app title and public project URL to OpenRouter. No conversation title or personal identity is included.
Key allowance, effective budgets and usage are separate from your account wallet.
An uncapped key does not mean unlimited account funds.
The returned allowance is exhausted. Your key is valid; review budgets or add credits.
The effective budget reflects overlapping restrictions. Individual budgets are not added together.
Overlapping reporting periods are shown separately. These totals come from OpenRouter for this key.
Account-wide balances and account changes are available on the OpenRouter website. They do not affect whether your inference key is verified here.
This key could not be authenticated. Check it and try again.
This key has expired. Create or supply another inference key.
This is a management or provisioning key. Use an inference API key here.
This resource or region is restricted. Your previous verified connection remains available.
OpenRouter reports a billing restriction. Review your account allowance.
OpenRouter is rate limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
OpenRouter returned an unexpected response. The key has not been verified.
Choose an official OpenRouter endpoint before validating.
Could not refresh. Check your connection and retry; cached values may be stale.
Recent receipts for this connection on this device, including earlier keys. Up to 500 are retained across connections. This is not your complete OpenRouter account history.
Optional: a management key has broad account authority. This app uses it only for account GET requests, never inference. It is not saved and this panel clears when you leave or background the app.
This account may differ from your inference key. Wallet and analytics are never combined with key allowance.
Some account resources are unavailable or restricted. Your inference connection is unaffected.
Account analytics · last 30 completed UTC days. Today is not included.
Could not export results. Retry while this connection is selected.
Jobs visible to the current key in its workspace, including jobs submitted by other keys. Refresh is manual.
Batch information is unavailable. Expired results may no longer be retrievable.
This sends a cancellation request for the selected workspace job. Work already completed may still be charged.
Older settings have no account identity. Apply them to this connection only if it is the intended owner. Credentials and profile overrides are kept.
A fresh response has been requested for the next call on this connection.
Delete the selected terminal batch and its stored artifacts from OpenRouter. Upstream deletion depends on provider support; billing records remain.
Cached queue entries for this connection
